```lean
theorem lg_target {G : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup G] [LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedAddMonoid G] [AddCommGroup H] [PartialOrder H] [IsOrderedAddMonoid H] {f : G → H} (h₁ : ∀ (x : G), f (-x) = -f x) (h₂ : StrictMonoOn f (Set.Ici 0)) : StrictMono f := by
  intro x y
  obtain h | h := le_total x y
  · exact (h₂ x y h)
  · exact (h₂ y x h)
```
